title: Fix keepalive authority recovery gaps found in TPP sync canary
body:
## Why

The generated Travel-Plan-Permission canary #1638 has three active P1 findings in manifest-managed keepalive authority recovery. A failed release can strand a prepared generation; a failed summary can rewrite attention before the reporter recovers it; and an available released state can be reused after its boundary or expiry changes. Consumer PR #1638 is source-owned and must not be patched directly.

## Scope

Repair the shared Workflows source, its exact consumer template copies where present, the sync manifest if coverage changes, and the defining keepalive and consumer-maintenance documentation. Regenerate the consumer through Maint 68 and let Maint 71 reconcile it.

## Tasks

- [ ] In `.github/scripts/keepalive_authority_state.js` and `.github/scripts/keepalive_loop.js`, keep a retryable exact-attempt reservation or recovery marker until authority-ledger release is confirmed; fail closed on uncertain writes. Address https://github.com/stranske/Travel-Plan-Permission/pull/1638#discussion_r4118823667.
- [ ] In `.github/scripts/keepalive_reporter_applicability.js` and the reporter workflow, recognize valid attempt-bound recovery when `summary` has already changed `challenge-due` to `automation-retry` and cleared the summary generation. Address https://github.com/stranske/Travel-Plan-Permission/pull/1638#discussion_r4128876117.
- [ ] In `.github/scripts/keepalive_authority_state.js`, rotate an available released state when its boundary fingerprint changes or its window expires while retaining receipt lineage and single-use safety. Address https://github.com/stranske/Travel-Plan-Permission/pull/1638#discussion_r4128876122.
- [ ] Extend `.github/scripts/__tests__/keepalive-authority-state.test.js`, `.github/scripts/__tests__/keepalive-loop.test.js`, and `.github/scripts/__tests__/keepalive-reporter-applicability.test.js` with a failing-before-fix case for each path and a restoration proof. Update `docs/keepalive/Agents.md`, `docs/ops/CONSUMER_REPO_MAINTENANCE.md`, and consumer template/`.github/sync-manifest.yml` coverage as needed.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `node --test .github/scripts/__tests__/keepalive-authority-state.test.js .github/scripts/__tests__/keepalive-loop.test.js .github/scripts/__tests__/keepalive-reporter-applicability.test.js` exits 0 on `main`, with deliberate-break or failing-then-passing evidence retained in the PR.

title: [P1] CI Docker smoke red on main: quay.io/minio/minio pull now unauthorized
body:
## Why

`main` CI has been red since 2026-09-27 (tip `4e384db`, [run 36362664895](https://github.com/stranske/Manager-Database/actions/runs/36362664895)). The `Docker stack smoke` job fails before the app starts:

```
Unable to find image 'quay.io/minio/minio:RELEASE.2025-05-24T17-08-30Z' locally
docker: Error response from daemon: unauthorized: access to the requested resource is not authorized
```

PR #1657 (merged 2026-09-13) moved this pin from Docker Hub to Quay because Docker Hub had started refusing anonymous pulls. Quay now refuses them as well. The last green `ci.yml` run on `main` was 2026-09-24. This is an upstream registry change, not a code defect. Picking a replacement image source is a judgment call, so it is filed here rather than guessed at.

## Scope

title: [sync-review] Fix upstream manifest-synced paths blocking stranske/Travel-Plan-Permission#1638
body:
## Why

Keepalive reporter recovery can reconcile an older workflow attempt after a newer attempt has already become active. Generation equality alone is not sufficient ownership evidence: a delayed reporter must not overwrite the newer attempt's running summary, and it must not project a settled receipt after the authority ledger has advanced.

## Scope

- Bind running keepalive summaries to the exact workflow owner attempt.
- Require recovered summary projection to match that exact attempt.
- Re-read the live authority ledger immediately before mutating the summary and stop when the settled receipt is no longer current.
- Propagate the superseded result through the reporter workflow.
- Keep the source scripts and consumer template copies synchronized.

## Non-Goals

- Redesign the authority ledger or serialize all reporter executions globally.
- Change challenge scheduling, retry budgets, or provider routing.
- Modify unrelated consumer behavior.

## Tasks

- [ ] Persist `running_owner_attempt` in `.github/scripts/keepalive_loop.js` when a keepalive worker starts.
- [ ] Match `projectRecoveredAuthorityState` in `.github/scripts/keepalive_state.js` to the exact running attempt and settled receipt identity.
- [ ] Revalidate the live authority ledger in `.github/scripts/keepalive_state.js` immediately before summary mutation.
- [ ] Return `superseded` from `.github/scripts/keepalive_reporter_applicability.js` and the reporter workflow when recovery is no longer current.
- [ ] Add adversarial regression coverage in `.github/scripts/__tests__/keepalive-state.test.js` and `.github/scripts/__tests__/keepalive-reporter-applicability.test.js`.

title: [sync-review] Fix upstream manifest-synced paths blocking stranske/Template#1051
body:
## Why

This is a verified current recovery break reported from `stranske/Template#1051`. In `.github/scripts/keepalive_authority_state.js:633-635`, `reconcileFailedAuthorityAttempt` returns a previously reopened `available` challenge directly when the same `recovered_receipt.owner_attempt` retries. That shortcut does not re-read the PR eligibility state or refresh the 24-hour authority window. Missing behavior: after the first ledger reopen succeeds but summary projection fails, a later reporter rerun can project an expired or stale generation after a force-push, removal of `agent:needs-attention`, or addition of `needs-human`, leaving keepalive stuck in retry/recovery.

## Scope

Harden idempotent recovered-challenge reconciliation in the Workflows source of truth and its byte-identical consumer template. Revalidate the exact attempt index, PR head, routing label, hard-human exclusion, and expiry before returning a settled reopened challenge. Rotate an expired eligible window while retaining enough generation lineage for safe summary projection.

## Non-Goals

Do not change challenge signing, consumption, confirmation, provider routing, or the hard-human boundary.
Do not patch `stranske/Template#1051` directly; consumer delivery must come from Workflows sync.
Scaffold-only or partial completion does not count: adding a helper without routing the recovered-receipt retry through it, or adding tests that do not exercise expiry and PR-state changes, fails this issue.

## Tasks

- [ ] In `.github/scripts/keepalive_authority_state.js`, route the recovered-receipt retry in `reconcileFailedAuthorityAttempt` through a validation-and-refresh helper analogous to `refreshReleasedChallenge`, including exact attempt-index and PR-state checks.

title: The approval packet tells an approver things that are not true ($0 cap, invented compliance score, cost 'from tpp')
body:
## Why

The approval packet is the one document this product hands an employer, and on the 2026-09-22 audit tip (8a7d81ad), driven in a browser against a live TPP service, it states things that are not true:

- **"Budget cap: $0 … Scenario total is $1,238 above the budget cap."** No cap was ever set. `frontend/src/components/workspace/ApprovalPacket.tsx:70-74` formats `budget_state.summary.planned_total`, whose unset default is `0.0` (`trip_planner/app/services/workspace.py`, resolved_budget_state default), and computes `planned_total - scenarioAmount`. TPP's real cap (BUD-001, $5,000) would leave $3,762 of headroom.
- **"Compliance score 15%"** (`ApprovalPacket.tsx:58`) is `0.15` hard-mapped from the outcome `non_compliant` in `trip_planner/integrations/tpp/client.py:1072-1074` (`1.0 if compliant else 0.45 if exception_required else 0.15`). TPP returns no score. It is a relabelled verdict shown as a measurement.
- **"itinerary: Chicago, IL runtime bundle from tpp — $1,238"** (`ApprovalPacket.tsx:92`) names the policy engine as the vendor. The per-component prices the traveller entered (United.com $486, Hyatt $612, meals $140) and their sources never reach the packet, although `GET /api/workspace/{id}/prices` serves them with `price_source`.
- **No traveller name, no origin, no itinerary, no approval area.** The packet prints trip, purpose, dates and destination only.
- **After a fresh sign-in the printed verdict reads "Not evaluated"** beside "Policy blocked this proposal: fare_comparison, …", because the evaluation result fetched in the browser session is not persisted.
- **A one-page packet prints three Letter pages; pages 2–3 are blank.** `frontend/src/styles.css:180-202` hides the app with `visibility: hidden`, which keeps its 2,047px of layout.

## Scope

`frontend/src/components/workspace/ApprovalPacket.tsx`, its print rules in `frontend/src/styles.css`, `trip_planner/integrations/tpp/client.py` (compliance score), and whatever backend change is needed for the packet to read persisted verdict detail and the entered prices.

## Non-Goals

- Do not invent a cap, a score or a figure to fill a gap. Absent means printed as absent ("No budget cap set", "Not scored by the policy service").
- Do not build a PDF service; the browser print path is the deliverable here.
- Scaffold-only work (new fields that render nothing, TODO sections) does not count as done.

## Tasks

- [ ] In `frontend/src/components/workspace/ApprovalPacket.tsx`, stop printing an unset c

title: [sync-review] Fix upstream manifest-synced paths blocking stranske/Travel-Plan-Permission#1638
body:
## Why

This is a verified current race in the authority-recovery path. In `.github/scripts/keepalive_loop.js:4699`, `preservePendingChallenge` becomes false when `authorityAttemptOwnsRecoveryReceipt` returns attempt-bound recovery markers. The summary then changes the effective disposition to `automation-retry`, and `.github/scripts/keepalive_loop.js:4995` dispatches a plain `force_retry` before the failed-run reporter can project the released or reopened authority generation. That ordinary retry has no signed authority claim and can start outside the single-use challenge path. The exact consumer finding is preserved at `stranske/Travel-Plan-Permission#1638` thread `discussion_r4149226639`.

## Scope

Keep the current authority generation challenge-pending when the failed owner attempt is proven to own the current-head recovery receipt. Preserve its attempt-bound recovery markers, retain the attention route, and suppress the ordinary retry dispatch until reporter projection settles the receipt lineage.

## Non-Goals

- Do not broaden authority grants, relax receipt ownership checks, or change unrelated retry behavior.
- Do not patch the generated consumer PR directly; `.github/scripts/keepalive_loop.js` is manifest-synced from Workflows.
- Scaffold-only or partial completion does not count: changing the disposition without a regression that proves no plain workflow dispatch occurs is incomplete.

## Tasks

- [ ] Update `updateKeepaliveLoopSummary` in `.github/scripts/keepalive_loop.js` so attempt-bound recovery markers preserve the current `challenge-due` presentation and cannot issue an ordinary `force_retry` dispatch.
- [ ] Extend `.github/scripts/__tests__/keepalive-loop.test.js` with the current-head recovery-owner regression, asserting the generation and markers survive, `agent:needs-attention` remains, and no `workflow-dispatch` action occurs.
- [ ] Update `docs/keepalive/Agents.md` to document that the owning failed attempt remains challenge-pending until reporter projection settles its receipt lineage.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `node --test .github/scripts/__tests__/keepalive-loop.test.js` exits 0 and the named test `summary input without exact job evidence cannot reopen or ordinarily retry a consumed authority receipt` observes `challenge-due`, the original generation, the exact recovery owner markers, no attention-label removal, and zero ordinary workflow dispatches.

## Why

This is a verified current break in the failed-run reporter path. The hourly sweep dispatches `.github/workflows/agents-keepalive-loop.yml` on the default branch while carrying the intended target only in `inputs.pr_number` (`.github/workflows/agents-keepalive-sweep.yml:196-208`). For such unassociated `workflow_dispatch` runs, `classifyReporterRun` verifies the originating run and producer revision but returns `{ status: 'skip' }` for an ordinary dispatch (`.github/scripts/keepalive_reporter_applicability.js:18-52`). If the run is cancelled or fails before its own summary job, `.github/workflows/agents-keepalive-loop-reporter.yml:38-52` therefore skips cleanup and can leave the intended PR falsely marked running. The concrete downstream symptom was reported at `stranske/Manager-Database#1738` review thread `discussion_r4149662507`.

## Scope

Persist a versioned ordinary-dispatch PR binding in both Workflows producer contracts, recover that binding only after exact originating-run and producer-revision validation, and pass the verified target through the root and consumer failed-run reporters. Preserve the authority-attempt index as the stronger source of truth when it exists and require matching running-attempt ownership before an ordinary cleanup mutates a summary.

## Non-Goals

- Do not reuse or weaken the authority-challenge receipt/index contract for ordinary dispatches.
- Do not treat a display title alone as trusted; originating repository, run ID, attempt, event, workflow path, source SHA, and exact producer contract must still be verified.
- Do not infer the PR head from the default-branch workflow run SHA.
